correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the Gaussian Fock basis normalization ||z^n||^2=n!, yielding exact orthogonal shift weights U_n/sqrt(n). The R<1 and R>1 alternatives follow from geometric upper bounds and mean-square positivity of maximal Binet modes. At R=1 a compact cyclic torus supplies an empirical distribution with first moment c_U; an explicit block-count sandwich shows epsilon*N(epsilon)->c_U and inversion yields k*s_k^2->c_U even with periodic zeros. Abel summation proves the monomial-order O(1) harmonic remainder. Finite checker samples only test coefficients and examples; no enumeration is used as an infinite proof. The stated assumptions explicitly exclude confluent roots and non-Ward cases.

value.rationale: The natural operator newly introduced for a broad family of recurrences is classified by the location of characteristic roots, and its critical singular-value Weyl constant is evaluated exactly across all finite irrational or rational phases. Cancellation of monomial weights does not change the asymptotic coefficient, which is nontrivial at periodic zero frequencies. The Jackson derivative shows a sharp, explicit factor-two boundary jump, making the invariant mathematically motivated rather than an arbitrary finite computation. No paper-sized contribution or unstated downstream application is asserted.
